baias-wine.note: CF, Zurich 6 April 2021: 'The live implementation of the supply chain solution, first revealed in December 2020, is complete and is already being successfully used in a proof-of-concept implementation with ... Baia's Wine.' The Dec 2020 announcement (forum t/42741) used the future tense and said full implementation would be 'operational in early 2021'. No end date found.

beefchain.note: CF post dated 11 Nov 2020: 'BeefChain's technology is being trialed using almost 1,600 calves'. The IOHK partnership was announced at the Cardano virtual summit in July 2020 (Cointelegraph, 23 Jul 2020) as a future plan. Trial still running in Nov 2020; no later status or end date found.

bolnisi-winemakers-association.note: Agreement announced 15 Sep 2022 (CF blog): pilot covers wine harvested in autumn 2022 and bottled in spring 2023. On-chain, the first OriginateNavio/Metabus record (metadata label 1904, which is the label in the cardano-foundation/originatenavio config, with body st='georgianWine') is from 23 Oct 2023. About 40 batched georgianWine txs ran until Nov 2025, the last one on 14 Nov 2025. No end announced, so no 'until' is set. Issuer address is not documented, so none is given.

georgian-wine-agency.note: Same programme and records as bolnisi-winemakers-association: the CF/NWA agreement was announced 15 Sep 2022 (cardanofoundation.org/blog/cardano-foundation-partners-with-georgian-national-wine-agency), and the first on-chain label-1904 'georgianWine' record is from 23 Oct 2023. These records cannot be split between the NWA's certificates and the wineries' supply-chain steps.

cardano-academy.note: README documents this mainnet address as the Cardano Foundation's Academy badge issuer (payment credential 5a8dd1a6…83ae3). The template's first commit is 17 Sep 2026. On-chain, the address receives outputs only from 10 Sep 2026 (73 txs up to 19 Oct 2026).

cardano-buidler-fest.note: Buidler Fest #2 took place in Da Nang on 24-25 Apr 2025. The address is the whitelisted issuer in UVerify's social-hub template, which was 'built for the Cardano Buidler Fest 2025 t-shirt experience'. On-chain it is active only from 19 Apr to 13 May 2025 (16 txs). Caveat: the same address also appears as the example whitelist in UVerify template READMEs, so it may be a UVerify team wallet.

barca-vision.note: The Andamio onboarding sessions for the Barça Vision team are evidenced by screenshots dated 28 Apr to 6 May 2026, and Barça Vision signed off milestone 2 on 14 May 2026 (Catalyst project 1300101). The project treasury script address is documented in evidence/D-treasury/treasury.md; its first on-chain output is on 12 May 2026.

pragma.note: These are the 2025 Amaru treasury scope addresses (ledger, consensus, marketing, mercenaries, contingency) documented in the journal/2025/*.md files. On-chain, the first output is 20 Jun 2025 at the ledger treasury (a test deposit and script registration) and activity runs to Apr 2026. The amaru-treasury repo was created 1 Jun 2025. The SundaeSwap/USDM swaps are from the 2026 journal (journal/2026/bin/swap.sh), which uses separate 2026 treasury scripts that are not listed here.

cardano-foundation.note: Earliest use is Cardano Ballot, the CF's e-voting app: 'October 27th, 2022: Voting for the Cardano Summit Awards 2022 goes live'. The CF Ballot 2023 blog (5 Dec 2023) confirms 'In 2022, the first Cardano Ballot iteration occurred'. Later uses: Book.io ('I Can Aiken', ~Sep 2024) and Reeve (2024 financial report on-chain, Q2 2025, per the CF Quarterly Q2 2025).

intersect.note: Clarity post: 'In December 2024, the Cardano ecosystem convened to ratify its founding Constitution', using a Clarity-built voting app, with the result anchored on-chain (tx 50612b80…). Later uses: Ekklesia DRep budget signalling from Apr 2025 (ballot on the 26 Apr 2025 snapshot closed 5 May 2025, intersectmbo.org/news/next-steps-with-the-budget-process) and Sundae treasury contracts for 2025 withdrawals.

cardano-builder-dao.note: Clarity's 'Introducing Cardano Builder DAO' (20 Mar 2025) describes funding temperature checks 'via a poll on the Clarity Platform'. The DAO's 12M ADA treasury withdrawal was enacted 17 Aug 2025 (cardanocube), and two governance cycles had run on clarity.vote by Apr 2026. The start of actual votes may be later than March 2025.

coinstore.note: Forum post (10 Aug 2025): '$USDA / $USDT Trading Pair is now LIVE on Coinstore!', linking to Coinstore's X post status 1953367154688180245, whose ID decodes to 7 Aug 2025.

dubai-police.note: The pilot was presented at the World Police Summit, 5-7 Mar 2024. Forklog: 'details about the duration of the pilot phase ... are currently unknown'. The link to d'ABIS is still inferred.

ethiopia-ministry-of-education.note: Conservative choice: 16 Mar 2023 is the earliest dated claim that the system is live (Hoskinson). The deal was announced 27 Apr 2021 with a 'pilot program' and a Q3 2021 launch target, but no actual go-live date was found.

ford-motor-company.note: The Iagon/Cloud Court PoC was announced 18 Jun 2025 with Ford as advisor. No end or outcome reported.

landano.note: The Catalyst Fund 12 PoC repo was created 6 May 2026 (last push Jun 2026). The README says 'all blockchain interactions use the preprod testnet', so there is no mainnet use.

mekong-club.note: Press release of 20 Sep 2022 announcing the partnership with NMKR: 'The NFTs will be showcased and available for auction on 29 November for #CryptoGivingTuesday'. The original page is now 404, so the Wayback copy is cited.

nairobi-securities-exchange.note: The NSE x Empowa Catalyst Fund 12 project was funded around Aug 2024. Empowa's projects page dates the project '2024–2026' and marks it 'Completed'. No exact kickoff month was found, so 2024-08 is the funding month.

nbx.note: Oslo, 28 Mar 2025: NBX 'now offers OTC minting and burning of the USDM stablecoin for its clients'. The issuance agreement was announced Apr 2024 (mfn.se 'NBX and Cardano's USDM stablecoin join forces to serve EU').

reef-data.note: Pilot with Reeve announced 28 Jul 2026 to record payment flows on Cardano.

samsung-electronics-america.note: Announced at CES, 6 Jan 2022: 2M mangroves to be planted by the end of Q1 2022, with veritree tracking each tree for 5 years, so no end date is set.

snekkies.note: NMKR case study: 7,777 NFTs sold out in the first whitelist phase in under 7 hours, with no date given. On-chain, policy b558ea5ecfa2a6e9701dab150248e94104402f789c090426eb60eb60 minted Snekkie0001… (7,777 assets) on 16 Apr 2024 only. The one-off mint is the NMKR use.

unsigs.note: NMKR blog (10 Jul 2021): more than 26,000 unsigs were 'minted and sold via an API white label solution based on NMKR Studio'. On-chain, policy 0e14267a8020229adc0184dd25fa3174c3f7d6caadcb4425c70e7c04 minted unsig00000 on 28 May 2021, with the last mint on 29 Jul 2021.

sri-lanka-tea-factory-owners-association.note: This is the date the MOU was reported (World Tea News, 8 Mar 2023). No actual trading on Palmyra was confirmed (stage: announced).

uttar-pradesh-forensics.note: 'On September 15, 2025, Trivolve Tech announced that its FMS had officially gone live on the Cardano Mainnet' (also reported by Coinpedia on 17 Sep 2025). The vendor press release reporting 1,000+ txs in the first 3 days is dated 18 Oct 2025.

veralidity.note: Video published 19 Feb 2024: 'Veralidity ... is excited to unveil its strategic use of Mehen's USDM.' This is an announcement only; no live merchants were found.

veridian-shareholders.note: Spin-out with shares tokenized under CIP-0113 reported 8 Oct 2026.

daedalus-users.note: IOG: Daedalus launched in 2017 with the Cardano mainnet (initial release 27-29 Sep 2017).

yoroi-users.note: Launched on mainnet 1 Oct 2018 (Hoskinson/Yoroi posts; see theinformerpost.beehiiv.com/p/new-cardano-wallet-yoroi-is-released-on-the-mainnet). EMURGO announced on 22 Jul 2026 that it would 'cease operations of SecondFi and Yoroi wallet'; the app is now recovery-only.

lace-users.note: Lace 1.0 went live on mainnet on 11 Apr 2023 (IOG blog, 14 Apr 2023).

nami-users.note: IOG (Nov 2023): Nami 'was launched in July 2021'. The end date comes from the Chrome Web Store listing: 'we integrated Nami into Lace in December 2024' (Nami Mode in Lace).

book-io-readers.note: Publishers Weekly (Oct 2022): the first title, a Gutenberg Bible replica, was published in mid-July 2022. Aggregators give 22 Jul 2022.

govtool-voters.note: Intersect announcement dated 'September 10' (2024, right after the Chang hard fork), giving the first-96-hours metrics.

catalyst-voters.note: IOG (11 Dec 2020): 'Any ada holder can vote in Fund2 ... Voting will start at 20:00 UTC on 15 December'. Fund 14 (Sept-Oct 2025) was the last round, but no formal end has been announced, so no 'until' is set.

intersect-budget-dreps.note: Intersect (2 May 2025): the current Ekklesia ballot (snapshot 26 Apr 2025) 'concludes on May 5 at 23:59 UTC'. This was the first DRep budget signalling on Ekklesia; GovTool had been used before it. The 2026 budget vote later used the Ekklesia-powered Hydra Voting Platform.

cardano-forest-donors.note: The Initial Tree Offering opened with the CF post of 25 Sep 2021 ('Participate in the Initial Tree Offering today'). The CF post of 15 Feb 2022 says donors gave 'over 1 million trees in just over three months', which puts the donation phase's end at about Jan 2022. NFT redemption continued during 2022.

jpg-store-nft-traders.note: New listings were disabled 23 Apr 2026 and the marketplace shut down 23 May 2026. No verified launch month was found (only '2021'); the on-chain contract history is the better source for 'from'.
